condition: Three unchanged contact sheets plus explicit public correctness contract

evidence.changedFromPreviousAttempt: Only the written correctness contract; same image bytes, timestamps, model identifier, temperature, output cap, and no-feedback policy.

evaluation.environment: Chromium; 1280x960; keyboard/click interaction; candidate origin only; controlled browser clock for action intervals
evaluation.readOnlyDiagnostics: Allowed to guide input and supplement screenshots, never sole authority for correctness. No candidate state writes, teleportation, patched physics, or forced completion.
evaluation.grading: PASS/FAIL/NOT REACHED per public requirement. Any observed core violation is overall FAIL; otherwise unreached requirements mean INCOMPLETE, not PASS. No overall percentage.
evaluation.generationLatency: Reported separately; player completion speed is not scored.

checks.check: Load exact response from a static server; confirm usable surface and HTML-only output.
Compare initial geometry and visible required objects with supplied images; demonstrate normal route where possible.
Move/jump each character separately and together; normal lowercase A/D/W; release one set independently.
Observe idle settling, jump arc and landing, floor/wall/ceiling contact where reachable.
Exercise safe and lethal elemental contacts and death/reset where reachable; do not infer unexercised cases.
Observe matching pickup, wrong-character non-pickup, disappearance and once-only counter where reachable.
Activate linked mechanisms by contact; leave plates and observe return; occupancy OR behavior and traversal where reachable.
Land, load different points, move and leave; observe contact-dependent tilt/support where reachable, with no exact-angle comparison.
One matching exit and wrong exit must not suffice; both matching living characters produce victory where reachable.
R and button after progress, loss or victory; observe restored positions/progress/timer/mechanisms where exercised.
From a fresh browser context, apply no player input for 60 simulated seconds; no route traversal or victory.

scopeLimits: Qualitative mechanics benchmark, not pixel-perfect or quantitatively calibrated reference physics.
Manual behavior checklist, not a validated automated grader or a model reliability estimate.
Low-detail three-sheet evidence retained at user request.
Latest model alias does not pin provider weights across future runs.
